scripts.convex:check: npm run convex:typecheck && npm run convex:codegen
scripts.convex:codegen: sh -c 'test -n "${CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT:-}" || { echo "CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT is required for Convex codegen dry-run. Run npx convex dev or set CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT." >&2; exit 1; }; npm --prefix convex exec -- convex codegen --dry-run --typecheck enable'
scripts.convex:codegen:local: sh -c 'if [ -n "${CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT:-}" ]; then npm run convex:codegen; else echo "Skipping Convex codegen dry-run because CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT is not configured."; fi'
scripts.xcode:test: npm run xcode:test:macos && npm run xcode:test:ios
scripts.xcode:build:ios: xcodebuild -project RecallOS.xcodeproj -scheme RecallOSiOS -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.xcode:build: npm run xcode:build:macos && npm run xcode:build:ios
scripts.phase1:check:local: npm run convex:typecheck && npm run convex:codegen:local && npm run swift:build:core
scripts.phase1:check: npm run convex:check && npm run convex:test && npm run swift:test:core && npm run xcode:test && npm run xcode:build
